name: zclass_world_world_to_grid_coords_clamped_ex
description: zClass_World::WorldToGridCoordsClampedEx reports raw grid coordinates, clamped grid coordinates, and whether the input was inside world bounds.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because dense x87 comparisons, _ftol conversions, imported floor calls, and stack-slot reuse keep HLIL from rendering clean high-level assignments.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this world-grid helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450650 validates the world->classData access, inside-bounds flag initialization, +/-0.1 clamp constants, _ftol conversion for clamped coordinates, imported floor for raw out-of-bounds coordinates, and return 0.
The native world-to-grid smoke verifies inside, lower-bound, and upper-bound cases, including distinct raw and clamped grid outputs plus the inside-bounds flag.
